title: Hint response (PROPOSED, not built yet)
description: Response of POST /api/v1/encounters/{id}/hints. Request body: { level } where level is 1, 2 or 3. 1 is a nudge, 2 points at the approach, 3 is the walkthrough. 404 if the encounter or level does not exist; 422 if level is not 1 to 3.
